issues.description: Duplicate React import statements in step-3/page.tsx causing module build failure (useState and useEffect defined twice). This blocks Fast Refresh and causes hydration errors across the app.
issues.root_cause: The file has two separate import lines from 'react': one with `useState, useEffect` and another with `useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState`. The SWC compiler rejects duplicate named imports.

issues.description: Radar chart with 6 dimensions (Warmth, Complexity, Organic, Layered, Heritage, Character) is missing from the step-4 fingerprint reveal screen.
issues.root_cause: Cannot fully diagnose without step-4/page.tsx source, but the radar chart component is either not imported, not rendered, or its data is not being passed correctly.

issues.description: Tweak input field is missing from the fingerprint reveal screen.
issues.root_cause: Cannot fully diagnose without step-4/page.tsx source, but the tweak input component is either not rendered or conditionally hidden.

fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.reason: Removes the duplicate React import that causes the SWC build error 'name is defined multiple times', which was blocking Fast Refresh and causing widespread hydration errors across the app.
